about.ex: The bus ride takes about twenty minutes.

absorbed.en: took over and made part of itself
absorbed.ex: The bank absorbed two smaller lenders.

achieve.ex: The school hopes to achieve better exam results.

acquired.ex: The firm acquired a small software company.

adoption.ex: Adoption of electric cars is growing fast.

example.en: The adoption of electric buses has cut pollution.
example.zh: 採用電動公車減少了污染。

note.meaning: 採用；採納。文中 adoption rate 指愛爾蘭對生物相似藥的採用率。
note.usage: 常見 the adoption of sth、adoption rate、widespread adoption；另一義為「收養」。

noteEn.meaning: the act of starting to use something new.

noteEs.exampleTr: La adopción de autobuses eléctricos ha reducido la contaminación.
noteEs.meaning: Adopción; acción de empezar a usar algo.
noteEs.usage: the adoption of algo; adoption rate. También significa adoptar a un niño.

noteHi.exampleTr: इलेक्ट्रिक बसों को अपनाने से प्रदूषण कम हुआ है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी चीज़ को अपनाना; ग्रहण करना।
noteHi.usage: the adoption of sth; adoption rate आम हैं; दूसरा अर्थ 'गोद लेना' भी है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 電気バスの導入で大気汚染が減った。
noteJa.usage: the adoption of ～、adoption rate（普及率）。「養子縁組」の意味もある。

noteKo.usage: the adoption of ~, adoption rate(도입률). '입양'이라는 뜻도 있다.

annual.ex: The town spends a lot on its annual festival.

approximately.en: close to a number, not exact
approximately.ex: The trip takes approximately three hours.

ascribes.ex: Doctors ascribe his recovery to good care.

at.en: showing a point, level or place

attributes.ex: She attributes her success to hard work.

example.en: He attributes his success to hard work.

note.meaning: 把…歸因於。文中指她將採用率低部分歸因於採購流程。
note.usage: 動詞 attribute A to B（重音在第二音節）；名詞 attribute 指「特質」，重音在第一音節。

noteEn.meaning: to say that something is caused by something else.
noteEn.usage: Common: 'attribute A to B', 'be attributed to'.

noteEs.exampleTr: Él atribuye su éxito al trabajo duro.
noteEs.meaning: Atribuir; considerar que algo es causado por otra cosa.
noteEs.usage: attribute A to B; be attributed to. Como sustantivo significa 'cualidad'.

noteHi.exampleTr: वह अपनी सफलता का श्रेय कड़ी मेहनत को देता है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी बात का कारण किसी और चीज़ को मानना।
noteHi.usage: attribute A to B; be attributed to आम हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: 彼は成功を努力のおかげだと考えている。
noteJa.usage: attribute A to B の形。名詞 attribute は「特性」。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그는 자신의 성공을 노력 덕분으로 본다.
noteKo.usage: attribute A to B 형태. 명사 attribute는 '특성'.

available.en: able to be bought or used

be.en: to exist or have a quality

bearing.en: bear in mind: remember and consider
bearing.ex: Bear in mind that the shop closes early.

benefit.ex: Small shops benefit from local festivals.

best-value.en: giving the most for the money
best-value.ex: We chose the best-value offer for the school bus.
best-value.ja: 最も費用対効果の高い

bill.en: total amount of money to pay
bill.ex: Our heating bill doubled this winter.

biological.ex: Some biological medicines must be kept cold.
biological.ja: 生物学的な；生物由来の

biologics.ex: Biologics are often very expensive to produce.

biosimilar.en: a cheaper near-copy of a biological medicine
biosimilar.ex: The hospital switched patients to a cheaper biosimilar.

blamed.ex: He blamed the traffic for being late.

bought.en: paid money to get (past of buy)
bought.ex: She bought a new bike last week.
bought.zh: 買下；收購（buy 的過去式）

business.en: a company's work in an area
business.ex: He runs the family business in Galway.

buying.ex: The buying process for new computers is slow.

by.en: through doing; showing amount of change

called.ex: This small fish is called a sprat.

cheap.ex: The bus is a cheap way to travel.

cheaper.ex: Trains are cheaper than taxis here.

choose.ex: It is hard to choose a good phone.

close.ex: The painting is a close copy of the original.

come.en: come onto the market: go on sale
come.ex: New phones come onto the market every year.

companies.en: businesses that make or sell things
companies.ex: Many companies make cheaper versions of this drug.

company.ex: The company employs two hundred people.

compared.ex: Prices are high compared with last year.

competing.en: trying to win the same customers
competing.ex: Two competing shops opened on the same street.

competition.ex: Strong competition keeps prices low for buyers.

complete.ex: The new bridge will take two years to complete.

complex.ex: The engine is a complex machine.

condition.ex: Asthma is a common lung condition.

consequently.ex: It rained all day; consequently, the match was cancelled.

conspicuously.en: in a way that is easy to notice
conspicuously.ex: The team was conspicuously absent from the final.

continent.en: a large land area; here, Europe
continent.ex: Prices are higher here than on the continent.

contingent.ex: The trip is contingent on good weather.

example.en: The job offer is contingent on a health check.
example.zh: 這份工作錄取要以通過健康檢查為條件。

note.meaning: 取決於…的；以…為條件的。文中指招標必須先有至少四種競爭產品才會啟動。
note.usage: 常用 be contingent on/upon sth；名詞 contingency 指「意外狀況、應變」。

noteEn.meaning: depending on a condition being met.

noteEs.exampleTr: La oferta de trabajo depende de un examen médico.
noteEs.usage: Se usa en la estructura be contingent on/upon algo.

noteHi.exampleTr: नौकरी का प्रस्ताव स्वास्थ्य जाँच पर निर्भर है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी शर्त पर निर्भर; उसी के अनुसार तय होने वाला।
noteHi.usage: be contingent on/upon sth आम प्रयोग है।

noteJa.exampleTr: その採用内定は健康診断が条件だ。
noteJa.usage: be contingent on/upon ～ の形でよく使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 채용 제안은 건강 검진을 조건으로 한다.
noteKo.usage: be contingent on/upon ~ 형태로 자주 쓴다.

control.en: power to manage how things are done

copies.en: things made to be like the original

copy.en: a thing made like the original

cork.en: a city in the south of Ireland
cork.ja: コーク（アイルランドの都市）

cork-based.en: having its main office in Cork

cost.en: to need an amount of money

countries.ex: Many countries use these cheaper medicines.

currently.ex: She is currently living in Cork.

do.en: helping verb (here: do not use them)

drug.ex: The new drug helps people with heart problems.

drugmaker.ex: The drugmaker plans a new factory in Cork.

drugs.ex: New drugs can slow the illness.

estimates.en: guesses a number using known facts
estimates.ex: He estimates the trip will cost €500.

example.en: something that shows what you mean
example.ex: She gave an example from her own life.

executive.en: part of the name Health Service Executive
executive.zh: Health Service Executive：衛生服務管理局

exemplifies.ex: This old house exemplifies local building styles.

example.zh: 這棟建築是現代設計的典範。

note.meaning: 作為…的典型例子；例證。文中指乾癬藥 ustekinumab 正是此問題的典型例子。
note.usage: 主詞通常是「例子」本身：A exemplifies B；名詞 example、exemplary（模範的）。

noteEn.meaning: to be a typical example of something.

noteEs.exampleTr: Este edificio ejemplifica el diseño moderno.
noteEs.meaning: Ejemplificar; ser un ejemplo típico de algo.
noteEs.usage: A exemplifies B; best exemplified by.

noteHi.exampleTr: यह इमारत आधुनिक डिज़ाइन का उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी बात का सटीक उदाहरण होना।
noteHi.usage: A exemplifies B; best exemplified by आम हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: この建物は現代デザインの典型だ。
noteJa.usage: A exemplifies B の形。best exemplified by ～ もよく使う。

noteKo.usage: A exemplifies B 형태. best exemplified by ~도 자주 쓴다.

expenditure.en: money spent, often by a government
expenditure.ex: Public expenditure on health keeps rising.

example.en: Government expenditure on health rose last year.
example.zh: 政府去年的醫療支出增加了。

note.meaning: 支出；開銷。文中指使用生物相似藥每年可減少近三千萬歐元的支出。
note.usage: 正式用語，常見 public/government expenditure、expenditure on sth、reduce/cut expenditure。

noteEs.exampleTr: El gasto público en salud aumentó el año pasado.
noteEs.usage: public expenditure; expenditure on algo; reduce expenditure.

noteHi.exampleTr: पिछले साल स्वास्थ्य पर सरकारी ख़र्च बढ़ा।
noteHi.usage: public expenditure; expenditure on sth आम हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: 昨年、政府の医療支出が増えた。

noteKo.usage: public expenditure, expenditure on ~, reduce expenditure.

expensive.ex: Rent in Dublin is very expensive.

extensive.ex: The library has an extensive collection of maps.

example.en: The storm caused extensive damage to the town.
example.zh: 暴風雨對小鎮造成大範圍的損害。

note.meaning: 廣泛的；大量的。文中 more extensive use 指更廣泛地使用生物相似藥。
note.usage: 常見 extensive use/research/damage/experience；副詞 extensively。

noteEn.meaning: large in amount or covering a wide area.

noteEs.exampleTr: La tormenta causó grandes daños en el pueblo.

noteHi.exampleTr: तूफ़ान ने शहर को व्यापक नुकसान पहुँचाया।
noteHi.usage: extensive use/research/damage आम हैं; क्रियाविशेषण extensively।

noteJa.exampleTr: 嵐は町に広範囲な被害をもたらした。
noteJa.usage: extensive use/research/damage の形が多い。副詞は extensively。

noteKo.usage: extensive use/research/damage로 자주 쓴다. 부사는 extensively.

failing.ex: He was fined for failing to pay his taxes.

firm.ex: She works for a law firm.

for.en: used to show purpose or who gets something

forgoing.en: giving up something you could have
forgoing.ex: She is forgoing a pay rise to save jobs.

example.en: She forwent her holiday to finish the project.
example.zh: 她放棄了假期來完成這個專案。

note.meaning: 放棄；錯失（原可得到的東西）。文中指 HSE 每年放棄近一億五千萬歐元的潛在節省。
note.usage: forgo sth（過去式 forwent，過去分詞 forgone）；勿與 forego（在前）混淆，雖常互用。

noteEn.meaning: to give up or go without something you could have.

noteEs.exampleTr: Ella renunció a sus vacaciones para terminar el proyecto.
noteEs.meaning: Renunciar a algo o dejar pasar un beneficio.
noteEs.usage: forgo savings/a chance; formas: forwent, forgone.

noteHi.exampleTr: उसने परियोजना पूरी करने के लिए अपनी छुट्टी छोड़ दी।
noteHi.meaning: कोई लाभ या चीज़ छोड़ देना; त्याग करना।
noteHi.usage: forgo savings/a chance; रूप: forwent, forgone।

noteJa.exampleTr: 彼女はプロジェクトを終えるために休暇を諦めた。
noteJa.meaning: （得られるものを）見送る、断念する。
noteJa.usage: forgo savings/a chance。活用は forwent, forgone。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그녀는 프로젝트를 끝내기 위해 휴가를 포기했다.
noteKo.usage: forgo savings/a chance. 활용형은 forwent, forgone.

fuller.ex: Patients need fuller information about their treatment.

further.ex: A further ten jobs will be created.

gap.ex: The gap between rich and poor is growing.

gave.ex: The teacher gave an example on the board.

generated.ex: The festival generated a lot of money for the town.

example.en: The new park is expected to generate many jobs.
example.zh: 新公園預計將創造許多工作機會。

note.meaning: 產生；帶來。文中指生物相似藥的競爭帶來約兩億三千九百萬歐元的節省。
note.usage: 常見 generate revenue/income/savings/interest/electricity；主詞多為事物。

noteEn.meaning: to produce or create something, such as money or energy.

noteEs.exampleTr: Se espera que el nuevo parque genere muchos empleos.

noteHi.exampleTr: नए पार्क से कई नौकरियाँ पैदा होने की उम्मीद है।
noteHi.meaning: उत्पन्न करना; पैदा करना या लाना।

noteJa.exampleTr: 新しい公園は多くの雇用を生み出すと見込まれている。
noteJa.usage: generate revenue/savings/interest の形でよく使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 새 공원은 많은 일자리를 창출할 것으로 예상된다.

giving.ex: The win put them top, giving them confidence.

grabs.en: up for grabs: available for anyone to get
grabs.ex: Two seats are still up for grabs.

greater.ex: Teachers want greater support from parents.

head.ex: She is the head of the science department.

health.ex: The country spends more on health each year.
health.zh: 衛生；醫療（health system：醫療體系）

healthcare.en: services that look after people's health

here.ex: This drug is not sold here.

highly.ex: The two paintings are highly similar.

however.ex: It was sunny; however, it was cold.

hse.ja: HSE（アイルランド保健サービス庁）
hse.zh: HSE 愛爾蘭衛生服務管理局

illness.en: a disease or period of being sick
illness.ex: He missed school because of a long illness.

illustrates.ex: This story illustrates the value of hard work.

in.en: inside; at a place or time

increased.ex: Increased traffic has made the roads busy.

itself.en: used to stress the company itself

just.ex: Just ten people came to the meeting.

kicks.en: kick in: start to work or happen

lack.en: the state of not having enough

lags.ex: Our town lags behind the city in internet speed.

languishes.en: stays at a low level without improving

lapses.ex: Your insurance lapses if you do not pay.

example.en: He forgot to renew his passport, so it lapsed.
example.zh: 他忘了更新護照，所以護照失效了。

note.meaning: （權利、合約等）失效；期滿。文中指原廠藥的專利到期失效後，生物相似藥才能上市。
note.usage: 動詞 sth lapses（不及物）；也作名詞 a lapse in concentration/judgement（疏失）。

noteEn.meaning: to end or stop being valid, often because time has passed.
noteEn.usage: Common: 'a patent lapses', 'allow something to lapse'.

noteEs.exampleTr: Olvidó renovar su pasaporte, así que caducó.
noteEs.meaning: Caducar o vencer (un derecho, contrato, etc.).
noteEs.usage: a patent/contract lapses; como sustantivo: a lapse in judgement (un descuido).

noteHi.exampleTr: वह पासपोर्ट नवीनीकरण भूल गया, इसलिए उसकी वैधता ख़त्म हो गई।
noteHi.meaning: (अधिकार, अनुबंध आदि का) समाप्त होना; अवधि ख़त्म होना।
noteHi.usage: a patent/contract lapses; a lapse in judgement (भूल) भी आम है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 彼はパスポートの更新を忘れ、失効してしまった。
noteJa.meaning: （権利・契約などが）失効する、期限切れになる。
noteJa.usage: a patent/contract lapses。名詞 a lapse in judgement（判断ミス）も。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그는 여권 갱신을 잊어서 여권이 만료되었다.
noteKo.usage: a patent/contract lapses. 명사 a lapse in judgement(판단 실수)도 쓴다.

largest.ex: This is the largest city in the country.

last.ex: We went to Spain last summer.

leads.ex: She leads a team of twenty people.

least.ex: You need at least two forms of ID.

less.ex: This model costs less than the old one.

level.ex: The level of uptake is still low.

loses.ex: The company loses money every winter.

low.ex: The price of bread is low here.

made.ex: These shoes are made in Italy.

maintains.en: says firmly that something is true
maintains.ex: He maintains that the plan will work.

make.en: to produce; make use of: use
make.ex: Factories make cheap versions of popular drugs.
make.ja: 作る；（make use of）利用する

maker.ex: The car maker opened a new factory.

making.ex: We are making good use of the new library.
making.hi: करते हुए (make use of: उपयोग करना)
making.zh: 做（make greater use of：更多利用）

manufactured.ex: These shoes are manufactured in Vietnam.

market.en: the business of buying and selling a product
market.ex: The housing market slowed down this year.

marketed.ex: The drink is marketed to teenagers.

may.en: can; it is possible or allowed

medicine.en: a substance taken to treat illness
medicine.ex: Take this medicine twice a day.

medicines.ex: Keep all medicines away from small children.

mind.ex: Bear in mind that the shop closes early.

more.en: a larger amount; to a greater degree

ms.en: a title used before a woman's name

much.ex: The new phone is much faster.

nevertheless.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went for a walk.

new.ex: She bought a new coat for winter.

not.ex: I do not like cold tea.

notably.en: clearly; in a way people notice
notably.ex: The weather was notably warmer this week.

noted.ex: She noted that prices were falling.
noted.zh: 注意到；指出（it should be noted：值得注意的是）

older.en: having existed for a longer time

original.en: the first one, not a copy

originator's.en: of the company that first made the drug

part.ex: Cost is only part of the reason.

parts.ex: The main parts of the house are built.

patent.en: legal right to be the only maker
patent.ex: The company holds a patent on the new engine.

patients.ex: The nurse looked after ten patients.

pointed.ex: He pointed to the rise in sales.

potential.ex: We discussed potential problems with the plan.

presence.en: the fact of existing or being there
presence.ex: The presence of police calmed the crowd.

problem.ex: There was a problem with the bus.

process.en: a series of steps to reach a result
process.ex: The hiring process took two months.

procurement.ex: Hospital procurement must follow strict rules.

example.en: The hospital changed its procurement process last year.
example.zh: 這家醫院去年更改了採購流程。

note.meaning: 採購（尤指機構或政府）。文中指 HSE 購買藥品的招標流程。
note.usage: 常見 public procurement、procurement process/policy；動詞 procure。

noteEn.meaning: the process of an organisation buying goods or services.

noteEs.exampleTr: El hospital cambió su proceso de compras el año pasado.
noteEs.meaning: Adquisición o compra de bienes por una organización o gobierno.
noteEs.usage: procurement process; public procurement; verbo: procure.

noteHi.meaning: सरकार या संस्था द्वारा सामान खरीदने की प्रक्रिया; खरीद।

noteJa.exampleTr: その病院は昨年、調達手続きを変更した。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 병원은 작년에 조달 절차를 바꾸었다.
noteKo.usage: procurement process, public procurement(공공 조달). 동사는 procure.

produced.ex: These cars are produced in Germany.

product's.ex: The product's price went up last month.

programme.ex: The government started a new health programme.

protracted.ex: After protracted talks, the two sides signed a deal.

example.en: After protracted talks, the two sides reached a deal.
example.zh: 經過冗長的談判，雙方達成了協議。

note.meaning: 拖延的；冗長的。文中指 HSE 採購計畫耗時長達 240 天。
note.usage: 多為負面意味：protracted negotiations/dispute/process；動詞 protract 較少用。

noteEn.meaning: lasting longer than expected or than usual.

noteEs.exampleTr: Tras largas negociaciones, las dos partes llegaron a un acuerdo.
noteEs.meaning: Prolongado; que dura más de lo esperado.

noteHi.exampleTr: लंबी खिंची बातचीत के बाद दोनों पक्षों में समझौता हुआ।
noteHi.meaning: बहुत लंबा खिंचने वाला; अपेक्षा से अधिक समय लेने वाला।

noteJa.exampleTr: 長引いた協議の末、両者は合意に達した。
noteJa.usage: 否定的な意味で protracted negotiations/dispute/process。

noteKo.exampleTr: 오랜 협상 끝에 양측은 합의에 이르렀다.

psoriasis.en: a skin disease causing red, dry patches

rate.en: level or amount, often a percentage

remains.ex: The shop remains open until late.

replicas.ex: The museum sells small replicas of the statue.

rival.ex: Two rival firms bid for the contract.

runs.ex: Her family runs a small hotel.

said.ex: She said the shop was closed.

saved.ex: We saved fifty euro by booking early.

savings.ex: The changes will make big savings.

second-biggest.ex: It is the country's second-biggest city.

second-lowest.ex: Our team had the second-lowest score.

paragraphs: The HSE could save almost €150 million every year on medicines. This is what the drug company Sandoz says.
Some medicines are very expensive. When they get older, other companies can make copies. These copies are called biosimilars. They work in the same way, but they cost less.
In 2025, these cheaper medicines saved the Irish health system about €239 million. But Ireland uses only 11 of the 26 copies sold in Europe.
Diane DiGangi Trench runs Sandoz in Ireland and the UK. She says the HSE's system is too slow. It can take 240 days to choose a new medicine.
One copy medicine for a skin illness could save €30 million a year. But only 30% of patients use it. The HSE wants 80%.
The HSE could save nearly €150 million a year by using more cheap copies of expensive medicines, according to the Irish and UK head of the drug company Sandoz.

These copies are called biosimilars. They are made when the original medicine loses its patent, and they work in a very similar way but cost much less. In 2025, competition from biosimilars saved the Irish health system about €239 million.

However, Ireland uses fewer of these medicines than most European countries. Only 11 of the 26 biosimilars available in Europe are sold here. Diane DiGangi Trench of Sandoz says part of the problem is the HSE's buying process, which can take 240 days and only starts when there are at least four competing medicines.
She gave the example of a medicine for the skin condition psoriasis. Its cheaper version could save almost €30 million a year, but only 30% of patients use it, while the HSE's target is 80%.
Sandoz, which bought the Cork company Rowex in 2024, was the HSE's second-biggest supplier of medicines last year.
The HSE could save almost €150 million annually by making greater use of lower-cost biosimilar medicines, according to the head of Sandoz in Ireland and the UK.

Biosimilars are near-identical versions of complex biological drugs, produced once the original product's patent expires. Diane DiGangi Trench, who leads Sandoz's UK and Irish business, said competition from biosimilars saved the Irish health system an estimated €239 million in 2025, but that a further €148.8 million could be saved each year.

According to Ms DiGangi Trench, Ireland has the second-lowest uptake of biosimilars in Europe, with only 11 of the 26 available on the continent marketed here. She partly blamed the HSE's best-value biologics programme, under which a tender is only triggered when at least four competing drugs exist, and which takes 240 days to complete.

She pointed to ustekinumab, used to treat psoriasis, as an example. Its biosimilar could save the HSE nearly €30 million a year, yet uptake stands at just 30%, compared with a target of 80%. She said some parts of the health service use the cheaper drugs while others do not.
Sandoz, the world's largest biosimilar maker, acquired Cork-based Rowex in 2024 and was the second-largest supplier of medicines to the HSE last year.
The HSE is forgoing almost €150 million a year in potential savings by failing to make fuller use of cheaper biosimilar medicines, according to the Irish and UK head of the Swiss drugmaker Sandoz.

Diane DiGangi Trench estimates that biosimilar competition yielded some €239 million in savings for Irish healthcare in 2025, with a further €148.8 million annually still up for grabs.

Ireland lags conspicuously behind its peers: just 11 of the 26 biosimilars available across Europe are marketed here, giving the State the second-lowest uptake on the continent. Ms DiGangi Trench attributes this partly to the HSE's best-value biologics programme, which only kicks in once four rival products are on the market and takes a protracted 240 days.

The psoriasis treatment ustekinumab illustrates the shortfall. Its biosimilar could trim nearly €30 million from the annual bill, yet uptake languishes at 30% against an 80% target, a gap she ascribes to a lack of control within the system.
It is worth bearing in mind that Sandoz, which absorbed the Cork firm Rowex in 2024, was the HSE's second-largest medicines supplier last year and would itself benefit from wider adoption.
